The Compact is a short vow, spoken with clean hands:

> We will not send fire where it has not been invited. We will feed it, thank it, and let it leave.

[[The Ashwardens]] keep the words, and [[The Last Coal]] is their proof that a guest can stay. In [[Ember Reach]], some households still knock on the stove before they strike a match. After [[The River Runs Dry]], more people started knocking, as if courtesy might bring the water back as well.
